## API de Wan 2.6 Flash {#wan-2-6-flash-api}

Wan 2.6 Flash es un modelo de imagen a video de Alibaba Qwen, disponible en la Venice API como `wan-2.6-flash-image-to-video`. Las solicitudes se anonimizan, por lo que el proveedor nunca ve tu identidad.

### Precios de la API de Wan 2.6 Flash {#wan-2-6-flash-api-pricing}

| ID del modelo | Variante | Privacidad | Precio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wan-2.6-flash-image-to-video` | Imagen a video | Anonymized | desde $0.0553 / s |

Precios por clip para `wan-2.6-flash-image-to-video` con audio:

| Duración | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s | $0.28 | $0.41 |
| 10s | $0.55 | $0.83 |
| 15s | $0.83 | $1.24 |

### Cómo usar la API de Wan 2.6 Flash {#how-to-use-the-wan-2-6-flash-api}

Envía solicitudes a `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` con `"model": "wan-2.6-flash-image-to-video"` y tu clave de API.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "wan-2.6-flash-image-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "image_url": "https://example.com/first-frame.jpg"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "wan-2.6-flash-image-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
